declared.concentration: c_j = amount_rank1(j) / max(OI_tf, sum top-20 amounts of j), bounded by 1; OI_tf = the market's /oi value at t_f (the day's frame time), not the OI at the snapshot time h

dates.collect_max: t8_h1_start + 63 d; nothing is collected after it
dates.h1_start: first complete capture >= max(h1_earliest, first run + 2 h), pinned in snap/t8_h1_start.json

oi_source.drop_granularity: a failed or integrity-violating /oi reply drops its WHOLE batch of up to 60 sorted condition ids at once (oi_lookup_failed), so missing markets come in batches, not singly
oi_source.filter: market OI at t_f >= 1000 (threshold unchanged from v1; its units are unverified unless /oi and single-market event OI agree, smoke criterion e)
oi_source.frame_time_t_f: reply-received time of each batch, stored per batch (plan.oi.t_f_batches) and per market (oi_t_f_epoch); max t_f must be strictly before every /holders request (asserted at each request)

missing_states.oi_absent: requested id missing from an otherwise valid reply
missing_states.oi_lookup_failed: request failed after retries (3 attempts per batch across chunks) or non-200 reply or reply that fails the per-batch count/identity assertion
missing_states.oi_nonnumeric: value present but not a finite number >= 0 (strings, null, bool, negative)

oi_source.mixed_clocks: accepting_orders / closed / event OI are capture-time values; the OI is the /oi value at t_f (hours later); c uses OI at t_f, not OI at the snapshot time h
oi_source.mode: EVERY base-frame market, condition ids comma-separated, batches of 60 (repeated market= parameters return one)
oi_source.network: a network failure after retries writes nothing (smoke) / leaves the resumable partial (snapshot) and exits 75
oi_source.never: imputed, zero-filled or carried over from another time
oi_source.per_batch_assert: reply is a list; every returned market was sent (identity, case-insensitive); no duplicate; count <= ids sent
oi_source.stop_rule: more than 2% of base-frame markets in any missing state: the smoke FAILs and the day's snapshot stops, recorded 'missed (oi_source)' apart from 'missed (stale capture)'
oi_source.stop_rule_reason: the same tolerance as the CB6/CB7 exclusion-key rule (--max-unverified-key-share 0.02): unavailable OI cannot reshape a 1,800-market daily sample by more than about 36 markets, and a handful of transient misses does not stop a day

sub_reasons.day_rolled: the UTC day changed between chunk start and the plan write (or a /holders request): refused, the day is 'missed (oi_source)' (before the plan) or closes INCOMPLETE (after it)
sub_reasons.oi_capture_gone: the capture pinned for a pending /oi frame vanished and the day ended
sub_reasons.unfinished_at_day_end: the /oi frame build ran out of day

frame.source: latest complete capture (rows.csv.gz + rows_ext.csv.gz), finished <= 2.5 h before the frame build starts

declared.incomplete_day: a plan still in progress after UTC midnight is consolidated with what was done and marked <day>.INCOMPLETE.json (n_planned, n_done)

marks.rule: YES best bid / ask of each stored market at every complete capture in [h, h + 30 h]

paging.rule: a 400 at offset > 0 is a capped window (unavailable), any other non-200 is a failed request; the smoke probes offsets 0 and 4000

prints.stored: all prints of market-days with c >= 0.5 on either token; else prints by top-5 holders of either token

sample.strata: group x market-OI tercile (cut points from that day's /oi frame, OI at t_f)

smoke.criteria: a: HTTP 200 >= 19/20; b: grouped by token, outcomeIndex in {0,1}, numeric amount >= 0, proxyWallet present, >= 1 non-empty; c: <= 20 rows per token; d: response time; e: OI units label (records the /oi value at t_f, the event OI of single-market events and the sum-top-20 ratios; 'units unverified' unless /oi and single-market event OI agree within the band, or if sum top-20 > 1.05 x OI for more than half of the markets); f: strict key fingerprint == pin; g: paging probe; h: /oi source (missing share <= 2% of base-frame markets). pass = a and b and f and h
smoke.discloses: realised frame and stratum sizes against the 1,500 + 300 sample
smoke.output: counts and ratios only, write-once, holders_smoke_v2.json

v1.cause: empty frame: the sidecar open_interest (Gamma market openInterest) is blank in all rows

window2_pin.rule: T8_H2_start >= max(T8_H1_end, pin time + 2 h); the pin time is recorded

wallet.hash: HMAC-SHA256(key, lower-cased proxyWallet), first 32 hex characters
wallet.key_file: ~/.arepo/wallet_hash_key (or AREPO_WALLET_HASH_KEY_PATH), mode 600, never created by CB8
